scripts.dev:v2:runtime: npm run canvas:prepare && node scripts/prebuild-electron-dev.mjs && node scripts/start-renderer-v2-dev.mjs
scripts.test:v2: cross-env XINGMANG_RENDERER=v2 vitest run src/renderer-v2 electron/platform --no-file-parallelism --testTimeout=30000 && npm run test:v2:browser
scripts.canvas:prepare: tsc -p canvas-v2/tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build canvas-v2 --config canvas-v2/vite.config.ts && node scripts/copy-canvas-assets.mjs
scripts.dev:runtime: concurrently -k "vite" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on -w 1500 tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 dist-electron/platform/entry.js dist-electron/platform/preload.js dist-electron/main.js dist-electron/preload.js dist-electron/canvas-preload.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.test.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer-v2.json --noEmit
scripts.test: vitest run electron src --no-file-parallelism --testTimeout=30000 && npm run test:node
scripts.test:node: node --test scripts/audit-development-dependencies.test.cjs scripts/copy-canvas-assets.test.cjs scripts/verify-canvas-provenance.test.cjs scripts/verify-canvas-renderer-boundary.test.cjs scripts/update-release-utils.test.cjs scripts/verify-release-artifacts.test.cjs scripts/verify-packaged-hardening.test.cjs scripts/macos-build-config.test.cjs scripts/ci-workflow-config.test.cjs scripts/publish-dl-landing.test.cjs && node --test e2e/maintenance-layout.test.mjs e2e/account-commerce-interactions.test.mjs && npm run test:ui
scripts.test:ui: node --test --test-concurrency=1 e2e/primary-views-interactions.test.mjs e2e/start-guide-interactions.test.mjs e2e/settings-interactions.test.mjs e2e/account-switcher-interactions.test.mjs e2e/management-v3-interactions.test.mjs e2e/maintenance-pages-interactions.test.mjs e2e/canvas-close-interactions.test.mjs e2e/shell-navigation-interactions.test.mjs e2e/app-v3-interactions.test.mjs e2e/ui-interactions.test.mjs
scripts.test:windows: vitest run electron src --no-file-parallelism --testTimeout=30000 && npm run test:node
scripts.compile:runtime: node scripts/clean-electron.mjs && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/minify-electron.cjs
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run compile && cross-env XINGMANG_LOCAL_BUILD=1 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.build:win:ci: npm run compile && cross-env XINGMANG_LOCAL_BUILD=1 CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --x64 --dir --publish never
scripts.build:mac:dir: npm run compile && cross-env XINGMANG_LOCAL_BUILD=1 CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --arm64 --dir --publish never
scripts.build:mac:ci: npm run compile && cross-env XINGMANG_LOCAL_BUILD=1 CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --arm64 --x64 --dir --publish never
scripts.build:mac: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:mac:dev-origin && cross-env XINGMANG_LOCAL_BUILD=1 CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg zip --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.release:build:unsigned: npm run compile && cross-env XINGMANG_UNSIGNED_RELEASE=1 XINGMANG_LOCAL_BUILD=0 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --x64 --publish never
